text: dsh-academy 是一个面向 DSH 的学术写作提示插件，通过 systemPrompt 服务注册科研人格段和规则段。它可提示模型说明依据与不确定性、避免虚构文献和数据、区分事实与推断，并按用户语言回答且保留论文标题和术语原文；persona、诚信规则和语言约定可分别开关，也能设置研究领域及提示段顺序。适合希望 DSH 在科研写作中遵循学术表达约定的研究者。源码未显示需要 API 密钥、账号或外部服务。

dsh-academy adds a research persona and academic writing rules to DSH through the systemPrompt service. It discourages fabricated literature and data, distinguishes facts from inference, and sets bilingual conventions. Users can toggle sections and configure the research field and section order.
想让 DSH 写科研内容时不要编造论文和实验数据。
怎样让回答区分文献事实和模型推断，并标明引用出处？
Make DSH follow academic language conventions and preserve original paper titles and terminology.
dsh-academy 的功能「科研人格提示」：向 system prompt 加入面向研究者的科研助手人格，并可在配置 field 中指定领域。插件加载时自动注册 persona 段，可通过 persona 开关停用。
dsh-academy 的功能「诚信与双语规则」：将防止虚构文献和数据、区分事实与推断、按提问语言回答等约定加入 system prompt。加载时按 integrity 和 language 配置组合规则段。

dsh-academy README · Academic mode for DeepSeek Harness：English | [中文](README_CN.md)

[](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-academy)

One small plugin that changes how the agent *behaves* on scholarly work: a research persona, the anti-fabrication rules that matter most in academic writing, and bilingual conventions.

It registers **no tools and no skills** — capabilities belong to other plugins. This is the behaviour layer that makes them read like a research assistant.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-academy
dsh web
```

dsh-academy README · What it adds to the system prompt：**Research persona** — the reader is a researcher who needs something that survives peer review, not a paragraph that sounds right.

**Academic-integrity rules** — never invent papers, authors, years, journals, DOIs or citation counts; never invent data; separate what came from the literature from what is your inference; make every citation checkable; leave judgement calls to the researcher.

dsh-academy README · Works well with：- [`dsh-ai4scholar`](https://github.com/literaf/dsh-ai4scholar) — 38 literature tools (Semantic Scholar, PubMed, Google Scholar, arXiv, bioRxiv/medRxiv, DOI full text, auto-cite, figures). The integrity rules are only enforceable when the agent can actually look papers up.
- [`dsh-research`](https://github.com/literaf/dsh-research) — the research skill pack (peer review, introductions, formatting, reference audit).
- [`dsh-slides`](https://github.com/literaf/dsh-slides) — writes a talk to a self-contained HTML deck, plus `.pptx` when someone else has to open it.
